page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with no margin notes. Running head at the top, centred, with the page number at the top right. The text is a Hebrew-Chaldee lexicon in roman type with Hebrew words, and the letter heading ח sits centred between entries.

main_text.p: זָרָ֫ד זְרִירָא Ch. Sternutatio. Plur.cum aff. זְרִידוֹי Sternutationes ejus, Jobi 41.9.
זַרְתָּ זְרְתָּא Ch. Spithama, mensura duodecim digitorum, Exod.28.16.
חִבָּא Ithpah. אִתְחַבָּא Ch. Latere, latitare, abscondere se, Thren.1.3.
חֲבִיּוּנִין Ch. Latibula, abscondita, abdita, Cant.2.14. Ecclef.10. v.ult.

חָבַב Ch. & Syr. Amare, diligere: Item Syr. Ardere, accendi, Praet. foemin. Pehal ܐܚܒܬ Si jam accensus est, Luc.12.49. Aphel אַחֵב Idem. Ithpah. אִתְחַבַּב Amari, diligi: Amore conjungi, conglutinari, 1.Sam.18.1.

חָבִיב, חֲבִיבָא, חֲבִיב, חֲבִיבָא, חָבִיב Ch. & Syr. Charus, amatus, dilectus. Plur. חֲבִיבִין, emph. חֲבִיבַיָּא. Foem. חֲבִיבְתָּא, חֲבִיבָא cum aff. חֲבִיבְתִּי Dilecta mea, Cantic.6.3. ܚܒܝܒܬܟ Dilecta nostra, ad Philem.2.
חִבּוּב Ch. Amor, dilectio: Dilectus, dilectum.
חִבְתָּא חִבָּא Ch. Idem. Cantic.2.5. constr. חִבַּת cap.4.9. Plur.cum aff. חִבָּתִיךְ Amores tui, v.10.
חֲבִיבָא Ch. Patruus, Levit.10.4. in Jon. Idem quod אַחַב, seu אח אב. חביבתא

page.notes: Hebrew and Syriac words are transcribed as closely as the scan allows; vowel points and the small superscript marks are only approximated, and several Syriac and Hebrew forms in the entries for חבב and חביב are uncertain. The first line is cut at its left edge ("phatic." is the end of a word from the previous page). The single letter ח is a section letter, given as a paragraph.
